mentions.name: OrderProof
mentions.description: OrderProof is the first offering in a chain-of-custody system for financial transactions. It records Shopify transaction evidence and generates PDFs to help merchants streamline chargeback disputes.
mentions.problem: Merchants lose chargeback disputes and need streamlined access to transaction evidence to fight them.
mentions.audience: Merchants (Shopify store owners) handling chargeback disputes
mentions.source_excerpt: Our first offering is OrderProof which records Shopify transaction evidence and generates PDF to help merchants streamline chargeback disputes.
